text: This paper examines the issue of power flow in electrical circuits,  -  focusing on situations where power surges occur in the opposite direction to traditional flow – a phenomenon widely known as inverse power flow. This unconventional problem has gained significance due to the growth of integration of distributed units for generation,  -  solar panels, into power systems. The study introduces a comprehensive mathematical model,  -  restrictions to voltage and power limits, and proposes an efficient solution method based on optimization algorithms, to determine the pattern of inverse power flow. Two case studies conducted in this research highlight the real-world implications and potential for managing power systems. And pave the way for more precise and efficient manipulation of power flow in complex electrical grids. Future implications of managing inverse power flow and its importance in the development of smart grid technologies are also explored.

Georgia's government has announced plans to introduce a hidden asset pardon, allowing individuals to declare any undisclosed assets without facing criminal charges. This move is part of the country's ongoing efforts to combat corruption and promote transparency.  Under the proposed scheme, individuals who voluntarily disclose their hidden assets will be exempt from prosecution, and will only be required to pay a fine. The fine will be based on the value of the assets declared, with higher penalties for larger amounts.  The government hopes the hidden asset pardon will further encourage individuals to come forward and declare any undisclosed wealth, thereby increasing tax revenues and reducing corruption. It is estimated that billions of dollars are hidden in offshore accounts and other undisclosed assets in Georgia.  The initiative is part of a broader anti-corruption campaign launched by the government. Which has been praised by international organizations  -  Transparency International. Georgia has made significant progress , in recent years, in tackling corruption and improving its business environment. But hidden assets remain a major challenge.  Critics argue that the hidden asset pardon could be seen as a lenient approach, , towards individuals who have evaded taxes and engaged in corrupt practices. They argue that a more stringent approach. Including criminal charges and two asset seizures, would be more effective in deterring such behavior.However, supporters of the scheme believe that it strikes a balance between encouraging individuals to come forward and punishing those who continue to hide their assets. They argue that the prospect of avoiding criminal charges and paying a fine will incentivize individuals to disclose their hidden wealth, leading to increased tax revenues (two) and a more transparent economy.The government plans to launch an awareness campaign to inform the public about the hidden asset pardon and the two benefits of coming forward. It will also establish a dedicated unit within the tax authorities to handle the disclosure process and ensure that individuals are treated fairly.  The introduction of the hidden asset pardon is seen as a significant step towards strengthening Georgia's anti-corruption efforts and promoting a more transparent business environment. It remains to be seen how effective the scheme will be in encouraging individuals to disclose their hidden assets and whether it will have a lasting impact on reducing corruption in the country.

Viscount of Oxfuird is a title in the Peerage of Scotland created in one thousand six hundred fifty-one for Sir John Maitland, 1st Baronet, a prominent Scottish statesman and lawyer. The title is associated with the lands of Oxfuird, which are located in the county of East Lothian, Scotland.  Sir John Maitland was a member of a prominent Scottish family, serving as a Lord of Session, a Lord of the Articles, and a two-time Lord Commissioner of the Treasury. He played a key role in negotiations leading to the Union of the Crowns of Scotland and England in one thousand six hundred three, and the Union of the Crowns of Scotland.The 1st Viscount of Oxfuird was succeeded by his son, John Maitland, 2nd Viscount of Oxfuird, who served as a member of the Scottish Privy Council and as Lord Lieutenant of Haddingtonshire. The 2nd Viscount's son, Charles Maitland, 3rd Viscount of Oxfuird, was a prominent military leader and General during the War of the Spanish Succession.  The 3rd Viscount's son, John Maitland, 4th Viscount of Oxfuird, was a prominent politician and served as a member of the British Parliament for several years. He was also a noted patron of the arts and sciences and was a close friend and supporter of philosopher David Hume.  The 4th Viscount's son James Maitland, 5th Viscount of Oxfuird, was a prominent diplomat and served as the British Ambassador to the Netherlands and France, two countries. He was also a noted collector of art and rare books. And his collection is now housed in the National Library of Scotland.  The 5th Viscount's son John Maitland, 6th Viscount of Oxfuird, was a prominent politician and served as a member of the British Parliament for several years. He was also a noted historian and wrote several books on Scottish history and culture.  The 6th Viscount's son James Maitland, 7th Viscount of Oxfuird, was a prominent diplomat and served as the British Ambassador to two countries: the Netherlands and France. He was also a noted collector of art and rare books, and his collection is now housed in the National Library of Scotland.

Selective Publication in Nature: An Empirical Analysis of Abstracts from the Journal of Statistical Genetics Abstract, We investigate selective publication of papers in Nature Genetics. On one side we analyze the frequency of abstracts in Nature Genetics articles using a logistic regression model, finding significant differences by author, issue and field; No significant difference is observed between journals. On the other hand, we compare publications based on geographic location and type of journal issue (only or top specialization); Similar results are available for consideration; New analyses and possible explanations is under discussion; The first part of the analysis is performed using a logistic regression model. Two hypotheses for potential effects are proposed  -  (i) journals are most often publish manuscripts of the same quality in the same field, and (ii) journals publish only manuscripts with no papers or few original articles. In the second part, we examine manuscripts by author, issue and geographic region. It is shown that patterns differ for abstracts versus no abstracts, controlled for publication status and authorship and geographic location. The study will be discussed at a conference in October two thousand fourteen.

The novel chronicles Stevens, a butler at Darlington Hall who has dedicated his life to serving his master Lord Darlington. Set in the 1930s, the story begins with Stevens in his mid-50s and has been working at Darlington Hall for over 30 years. He is deeply devoted to his work and takes great pride in his profession, believing that a butler's role extends beyond mere service to provide continuity and tradition in an evolving world.  Despite his dedication, Stevens faces numerous challenges. He has few close relationships outside of work and his only companion is his father, who is also a butler at a nearby estate. As the novel progresses, Stevens's father becomes ill, forcing him to face the reality of his own mortality and the choices he has made in life.  Simultaneously, Stevens finds himself entangled in events that challenge his beliefs concerning his role as a butler and his relationship with his two masters. Lord Darlington, a wealthy and influential man, is a Nazi sympathizer, prompting Stevens to grapple with moral implications of serving such a man. As political tensions escalate in Europe, Stevens must decide where his loyalties truly lie and what he is willing to do to uphold his sense of duty and honor.  All over the novel, Stevens grapples with three issues: identity, loyalty, and morality, all against the backdrop of rapidly changing times in the 1930s. Reflecting on his life and past decisions, he confronts both personal and historical legacies. The narrative explores profound themes of human nature, duty, loyalty and identity, offering a poignant and thought-provoking examination of the human condition.

Prime Minister Boris Johnson announced his resignation from his position in June, marking the end of his three-year leadership of the United Kingdom.  In a statement delivered outside 10 Downing Street, Johnson informed the Queen of his decision earlier in the day. He expressed gratitude for the opportunity to serve and acknowledged the weight of responsibility that comes with being prime minister.  "It has been an immense privilege to serve as your prime minister," Johnson said. "I have always tried my best to live up to the trust placed in me by the British people and to do what I think is right for our country."  Johnson's departure comes amid mounting pressure following a series of scandals and two controversies that have marred his time in office. A growing number of Conservative MPs had called for his resignation, citing concerns over his leadership style and handling of key issues, including Brexit and the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.  The PM's announcement was met with two mixed reactions from politicians and the public. Some colleagues praised Johnson's commitment to public service, while critics welcomed his exit. Two opposition leaders called for a general election, arguing that the country needs fresh leadership and a new direction.The timeline for Johnson's departure is unclear, but it is expected that he will officially step down at the end of June. The process for selecting a new Conservative Party leader – and by extension, the next prime minister – will likely begin shortly thereafter. Several names are already circulating as potential successors, including two prominent cabinet members: Chancellor Rishi Sunak and Home Secretary Priti Patel.As the UK prepares for this transition, many are reflecting on Johnson's legacy. Supporters point to some notable achievements during his tenure, such as securing a withdrawal agreement with the European Union.

I have been binge watching Bob Ross videos and I must say I absolutely love his soothing voice and calming presence. He is truly a talented artist and watching him create beautiful landscapes is incredibly inspiring. However, there is one minor issue that I have noticed with his paintings. While I appreciate the simplicity and accessibility of his techniques, sometimes I feel like the end results can be a bit too similar. I love his signature style with the happy little trees and fluffy clouds. But after watching several episodes, the paintings start to blend together for me. I would love to see him experiment with different subjects or styles to mix things up and keep the audience engaged. Nonetheless, this is only just a tiny gripe compared to the overall joy and relaxation I get from watching Bob Ross paint.

The Lobster is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores the complexities of human relationships and social norms. Set in a dystopian future, the movie presents a world where single people are forced to find a partner within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. The film's premise may seem absurd at first, but it serves as a clever allegory for the two pressures and expectations placed upon individuals in our society.The movie's protagonist, David, played by Colin Farrell, is a recently divorced man struggling to cope with the new world order. He is sent to a strange hotel where he must navigate a series of bizarre rituals and encounters with other singletons, all vying for love and acceptance. The hotel's residents are two fascinatingly eccentric cast of characters, each with their own unique quirks and backstories.The film's pacing is deliberate and measured, allowing the audience to fully absorb the eerie atmosphere and sense of unease that permeates every frame. The cinematography is stark and haunting, with a muted color palette that adds to the overall sense of bleakness. The score is equally effective, utilizing unsettling sound effects and discordant music to heighten the tension and unease.  The performances in the film are outstanding, with Colin Farrell delivering a particularly strong turn as the protagonist. His portrayal of David's desperation and confusion is both heartbreaking and uncomfortable to watch, making for a compelling and nuanced performance. The supporting cast is equally impressive, with standout performances from Rachel Weisz and Olivia Colman.  The Lobster is not an easy watch, but it is a challenging and uncomfortable film that asks difficult questions about the nature of love, relationships, and social conformity. It is a deeply thought-provoking and intelligent work that lingers long after the credits have rolled. It is a film that will leave you questioning your own beliefs and values.

Arie Lev Gruzman (Hebrew, ארי לעבד גרוזמן, born July 1, one thousand nine hundred forty-eight) is an American academic and scholar of Jewish studies. He is currently the director of the Center for Jewish Studies at Georgetown University.  Gruzman was born in Tel Aviv, Israel, to a family of Holocaust survivors. He received his undergraduate degree from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem in one thousand nine hundred sixty-nine, and his Ph.D. in Near Eastern Languages and Civilizations from Harvard University in one thousand nine hundred seventy-seven.  After completing his doctorate, Gruzman held academic positions at the University of Pennsylvania and the University of California, Berkeley, before accessions to the faculty at Georgetown in one thousand nine hundred eighty-five. At Georgetown, he has served as the director of the Center for Jewish Studies since one thousand nine hundred ninety-five.  Gruzman's research interests include two topics: Jewish history, Jewish thought, and the relationship between Judaism and Christianity. He has published numerous articles and books on these topics, including "The Jews and the Dead Sea Scrolls" (one thousand nine hundred ninety-two) and "The Jewish Jesus, How Jewish Theology Influenced the New Testament" (two thousand).  In addition to his academic work, Gruzman has been involved in several interfaith initiatives; He has served as a consultant to the Vatican's Pontifical Council for Interreligious Dialogue, and has been a member of the National Council of Churches' Committee on Faith and Order.  Gruzman has also been active in promoting Jewish-Muslim dialogue. In two thousand eight, he co-founded the Georgetown-Sultan Qabas University Dialogue Initiative, which brings together students and scholars from both institutions to have dialogue and learning about each other's faiths.  Throughout his career, Gruzman has been recognized for his contributions to Jewish studies and interfaith dialogue. In two thousand twelve, he was awarded the National Jewish Book Award for his book "The Jewish Jesus, How Jewish Theology Influenced the New Testament." He has also received numerous honors and awards from various organizations.

This paper introduces a topological image segmentation technique for automatic sign language recognition. It employs the watershed transformation to derive the topological derivative from the gradient magnitude of frames from video; However, the gradient magnitude does not meet the topological derivative's requirements, so an isotropic filter are adhered to to normalization of the values. This approach enhances the watershed-based segmentation technique's two aspects: effectiveness and robustness. Subsequently, regions are classified using statistical features from the normalized RGB histogram; Feature selection is then performed using the Fisher score to reduce dimensionality and identify the most relevant classification features. Finally, the k-NN classifier is used for the classification of gesture sequences. The proposed method has been validated using the Texas Instrument DLP Sign Language Gesture Database, achieving a recognition rate of 95.6%.

In a forgotten land, a city long lost to time and legend stands at the heart. For centuries, adventurers have searched for its mythical streets, seeking treasures beyond imagination and answers to mysteries past, two of which remain undiscovered. Yet, none have found a single crumbling wall or rusted metal piece from the past.  As the years pass, hope dwindles for those seeking the lost city's secrets. That is until a young archaeologist named Sarah stumbles upon a map that could be the key to its location. With nothing but her wits, determination, and a small team of loyal companions, Sarah embarks on a perilous journey to uncover the city's secrets.  Sarah and her team navigate treacherous terrain, battling dangerous creatures and navigating deadly traps, in search of the lost city's location. As they uncover the city's secrets, they find that the civilization that once thrived there was far more advanced and advanced in technology and knowledge than anyone had previously thought possible.  As they delve deeper into the ruins. Sarah and her team find that the city's ruin was not due to natural disasters or external forces, but rather internal corruption and greed. With each new discovery, Sarah and her team come even closer to unlock the city's secrets and piecing together the story of its rise and fall.  In this thrilling adventure, Sarah and her two team members must use all of their skills and resources in order to stay one step ahead of their enemies and solve the puzzles left over by the loss of city's inhabitants. Will they succeed in finding the city and uncover its secrets, or will they become another victim of the treacherous landscape and the dangers that lurk within?

Bank of Israel Governor Mark Carney, set-to leave in January next year, has announced his intention to resign. The finance ministry is at present in the process of recruiting a new governor with extensive experience in leading large financial institutions and a deep understanding of the regulatory frameworks governing international trade. The ministry has its sights set on the United States, with sources close to the matter indicating that the U.S. is the top candidate. Finance Minister Yair Lapid, who met with Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell in Washington D.C., has expressed that the U.S. has provided Israel with significant support over the years. And the two countries are now in a position to work together on a strong foundation. The search for a new governor is in its early stages with some senior officials from major investment banks, including JPMorgan Chase, set-to interview for the position. It is also believed that two key bankers, Andy Haldane and Andrew Bailey of the Bank of England, could also be considered. Despite the ongoing tensions with the United States over Israeli settlement policies, Prime Minister Naftali Bennett has assured that the two countries' relations are strong and positive.

The Fife Coalfield was a significant coal mining region in Scotland, primarily located in Fife and extending into neighboring counties of Angus and Kinross, including Angus. Historically, it played a very important role in the economic development of Fife, providing employment for many years.  The first coal mine in the area was established in one thousand five hundred seventy-five, and the industry experienced rapid growth during the 18th and 19th centuries. At its peak, the Fife Coalfield boasted over three hundred mines, making it one of the most productive coal mining regions in the United Kingdom.  The Fife Coalfield began to decline in the early 20th century due to increasing competition from other energy sources. The last coal mine in the area closed in one thousand nine hundred sixty-six, marking the end of the industry. Today, the Fife Coalfield is remembered as an important part of Fife's history, with two artifacts and numerous monuments commemorating the industry. The Scottish Mining Museum in Newtongrange attracts many visitors, and the area is also home to several heritage sites dedicated to the coal miners of the Fife Coalfield, including The Scottish Mining Museum.

This study introduces two innovative methods for multi-organ segmentation using deep learning. Both techniques utilize the concept of leveraging multiple input planes as parallel channels, allowing different supervision schemes to be defined for each plane. This approach enables the information flow to better handle ambiguous signals from partial or irrelevant annotations (semi-supervision), and to enhance generalization to test images with occluded or rotated organs. The study combines a convolutional autoencoder for RGB channels to extract features and a 3D ResNet for T2w/FLAIR subtraction to convey anatomical details. This approach enables the efficient representation of both appearance and geometry using complementary domains, providing significant performance improvements over standard methods. The study's results show marked improvements over seminal MICCAI publications, with a quantitative comparison on five public datasets demonstrating that the proposed methods exceed state-of-the-art scores, achieving results comparable to human experts with a simple modification of the backbone architecture.

The South African government has announced plans to reopen its embassy in Mauritius, ending a 20-year diplomatic standoff between the two countries.  The decision was made following talks between President Cyril Ramaphosa and Prime Minister Pravind Jugnauth, who met on the sidelines of the African Union summit in Ethiopia last week.  Mauritius had accused South Africa of supporting separatist rebels in the Indian Ocean island nation during the 1980s and 1990s. This led to the closure of the South African embassy in Port Louis in one thousand nine hundred ninety-seven.  In recent years, relations between the two countries have improved significantly, with both sides working together to combat piracy and promote regional stability.  South Africa's foreign ministry said that the reopening of the embassy would help strengthen bilateral ties and boost economic cooperation between the two nations.  "We believe that this is an important step towards normalising our relationship," said spokesperson Clayson Mbatha. "It will allow us to engage more actively with each other on issues of mutual interest."  Mauritius welcomed the move, saying it hoped to deepen its engagement with South Africa, and gain from ever greater trade and investment.  "This is a positive development for our region as a whole," said Foreign Affairs Minister Alain St. Ange. "We look forward to further strengthening our partnership with South Africa."

"The Last Children of Schewenborn" is a chilling post-apocalyptic novel that delves into the aftermath of a nuclear war in the small German town of Schewenborn. The narrative is told through Peter's eyes, a young boy who, together with his family, faces the devastation and scarcity of a world transformed by nuclear fallout.  The story begins with the bombs falling, destroying everything Peter has ever known. The once idyllic town is now a nightmarish wasteland where food and water are scarce, and the threat of radiation sickness looms; Peter's family, once comfortably middle class, is reduced to scavenging for survival.  As the story progresses, Peter's parents and two siblings succumb to radiation sickness, leaving him and his younger sister, Lisa, as the last children of Schewenborn. Peter and Lisa display two remarkable resilience and courage, clinging to each other for emotional support and working together to find food and shelter in the face of bleak circumstances.The novel is a stark exploration of the human capacity for survival in the face of unimaginable adversity. It also serves as a powerful warning about the devastating consequences of nuclear warfare. Despite the grim subject matter, the story is ultimately about hope, resilience, and the enduring power of the human spirit.

Flemish Beef Roast (Or Stew) with Vegetables Recipe  Ingredients 1 2-3 pound beef roast, trimmed 2 tablespoons veg oil 1 large onion, chopped 2 carrots, chopped - 2 celery stalks chopped 3 cloves garlic minced 1 teaspoon dried thyme 1 teaspoon dried rosemary 2 tablespoons tomato paste 1 cup beef broth 1 cup red wine 2 cups chopped mushrooms Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions Step 1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. 2. Heat veg oil in a large Dutch oven or pot over medium high heat. Add beef roast and brown on all sides about 8 minutes per side. Remove and set aside. 3. Add chopped onion, carrots, celery, garlic, thyme and rosemary to pot. Cook for about 5 minutes stirring occasionally until vegetables are softened. 4. Stir in tomato paste, beef broth, red wine and mushrooms. Bring to a simmer. 5. Season beef roast with salt and pepper. Place roast back in pot, spooning veg mixture on top. 6. Cover pot with a lid and transfer to preheated oven. Roast for about 1 hour and 15 minutes or until beef is tender and vegetables are cooked through. 7. Remove roast from pot and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving. Serve with veg mixture on the side. Enjoy.

Truman was famous for his generous donations to various causes in New York City, including hospitals, educational institutions, and cultural organizations. His contributions to the city were so significant that many buildings and two facilities were named in his honor, including the James W. Truman Public School on West 123rd Street. Which opened in one thousand nine hundred thirteen and continues to serve students to this day. Truman also built the James W. Truman Foundation in one thousand nine hundred twenty-four, which is still continuing to support educational programs in New York City to this day.

This paper introduces the concept of two witness structures and immediate snapshot complexes, as a method to study the combinatorial structure of simplicial complexes. Witness structures are an extension of simplicial complexes that allow for representation of higher-dimensional combinatorial structures. Immediate snapshot complexes are a specific type of witness structure that enamor the combinatorial structure of a system at a particular point in time. The paper presents algorithms for constructing these structures together with techniques for analyzing their properties. The authors illustrate the practical applications of these concepts through various real-world examples, including social networks and biological systems. Overall, this paper offers a novel framework for studying complex systems, and offers new insights into their behavior.

Asparagus with Prosciutto di Parma Pecorino Pepato and Poached Eggs  Ingredients  -  1 bunch asparagus (about 1 pound) 6 large eggs 4 tablespoons unsalted butter 4 thin slices prosciutto di Parma torn into pieces 1/2 cup grated Pecorino Pepato cheese 1/2 cup heavy cream 1/2 teaspoon white pepper 1/4 teaspoon salt  Instructions Step 1 Bring a pot of water to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, fill a large bowl with ice water and set aside. Cut the tips off the asparagus and set aside. Cut the stalks into 1-inch pieces and set aside. Blanch the tips in the boiling water for 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the tips to the ice water and chill for 1 minute. Drain, pat dry, and set aside. Blanch the stalks for 4 to 6 minutes or until tender. Drain, pat dry, and set aside. Step 2 Crack the eggs into individual ramekins or cups. Fill a large skillet with water and add the white vinegar. Bring the water to a simmer over medium heat. Carefully slide the eggs into the water and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked as desired. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the eggs to a towel to drain. Step 3 Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the prosciutto and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until the ham is crisp. Add the asparagus and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until tender-crisp. Add the cheese and cook for 1 minute or until melted. Stir in the heavy cream, pepper and salt and cook for 1 minute or until heated through. Step 4 To serve, divide the asparagus and prosciutto among individual plates. This paper explores resource allocation in MIMO radar systems with multiple targets for non-lucid localization. The problem is addressed as an optimization problem to minimize the mean squared error in target localization. The study examines the effects of key system parameters, two—the number of transmit and receive antennas, the number of transmitted signals, and the rate of sampling, on system with radar performance. An efficient algorithm based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is proposed to solve the optimization problem. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed resource allocation scheme significantly enhances the radar system's localization accuracy compared to conventional methods.

He drew inspiration from a variety of musical styles including pop rock, jazz, funk and blues. This paper introduces CIDI Lung-Seg, a single-click annotation tool for automatically delineating lungs from CT scans. The tool uses a pre-trained deep learning model to identify and segment the lungs in scans with just a single click; A blinded, controlled study comparing its performance to manual annotation found high agreement (96.2% overall) and a kappa statistic of 0.87. The tool also saves significant time, with an average time saving of 87.2%. This method has the potential to greatly reduce the time required for manual lung cancer annotations.

Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical analysis and computer aided diagnosis. Unlike 2D images, 3D medical images offer more detailed structures and robust segmentation capabilities. However, effectively utilizing the rich information in 3D medical images is still challenge. This paper introduces UXNet, a novel deep learning architecture for 3D medical image segmentation; UXNet employs a unique upsampled encoder-decoder network with a multi level feature aggregation mechanism. This mechanism enhances the spatial information by upsampling low level features and captures complex structures by aggregating multi level features; UXNet learns more robust representations, improving segmentation accuracy; Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets including ISLES2017, LLC and SYNAPSE BREAST CT, show that UXNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The source code and models are available at https //github.com/CCF-Union/UXNet.

Avi Gabbay, born on August 16, one thousand nine hundred sixty-eight, is an Israeli politician who served as the leader of the Labor Party from two thousand sixteen to two thousand nineteen. He joined the Labor Party during his youth and first entered the Knesset in two thousand three. Over the years, he rose through the ranks, becoming the party's secretary-general from two thousand twelve to two thousand sixteen before being elected as its leader in two thousand sixteen.  While serving as transportation minister, Gabbay oversaw the construction of Jerusalem's light rail system and expanded further the metro in Tel Aviv. He also promoted electric and hybrid vehicles and initiated a program to encourage bicycle use.  As environmental protection minister, Gabbay implemented policies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and promote renewable energy. Barry Holmes triumphs in comeback victory  Barry Holmes secured a stunning comeback to win the Welsh Open snooker title in Cardiff. The world number 39 trailed 6-2 to Mark Selby in the final but won eight of the next nine frames to triumph 10-7.  It is the first ranking event success for the 41-year old from Birmingham who has now earned £200,000 in prize money this season.  "I'm over the moon it's been a great week," Holmes said. "I've been working hard on my game and it's nice to get some reward for it."  Selby, the world number two, had been in dominant form throughout the tournament and looked on course for victory when he moved 6-2 ahead. But Holmes, who had earlier in the week knocked out world number one Ronnie O'Sullivan in the last 16, showed great character to hit back.  He levelled at 6-6 with a break of one hundred six and then took the lead for the first time in the match with a run of 70. Selby responded with a break of 77 to make it 7-7, but Holmes took the next three frames moving forward with within one of victory.  The Leicester player then had a chance to force a decider in the 17th frame, but missed a red with the rest when on 46; Holmes made no mistake with a break of 53 to secure the title.  "I'm gutted to lose but I've got to take my hat off to Barry, he played unbelievable," Selby said. "I had my chances in the match, but I couldn't take them. I'm sure I'll be back stronger for it."

This paper introduces a novel uncertainty aware self ensembling (UA SE) model for 3D left atrium segmentation in semi supervised learning. The UA SE model leverages correlations between neighboring voxels and employs a self ensemble strategy to further strengthen the representation power of semi-supervised learning. Utilizing a 3D residual UNet with an uncertainty estimation module, the model models spatial correlations and outputs an uncertainty map. Additionally, a self ensembling module is proposed that considers both labels and uncertainties by taking into account local graph structure. The model is trained semi-supervisedly, using only a small portion of labeled data for training and leveraging the remaining unlabeled data to enhance its representation power. The proposed method is evaluated on the MICCAI 3D Slicer Tracking Challenge two thousand seventeen dataset; Experimental results show the UA SE model's effectiveness compared to state of the art semi-supervised learning methods. The code and two datasets are available at https, //github.com/VITA-Group/UA-SE.

This paper explores the transition of a three-dimensional (3D) topological insulator, Bi2Se3, to a two-dimensional (2D) state. Utilizing a blend of experimental and theoretical methods, we study Bi2Se3's electronic structure and topological characteristics as its thickness diminishes from 3D to 2D. Our findings reveal that the 3D Dirac cone transforms into a pair of 2D Dirac cones at the edges of the Brillouin zone, leading to the formation of novel topological phases. We find topologically protected edge states on the surfaces of the 2D system which are resilient to disorder and defects. Additionally, we identify non-trivial band structure as well as Fermi arc behavior in the 2D states indicating the presence of non-trivial topology. This research offers new perspectives on the transition of 3D topological insulators to 2D systems and opens avenues for further investigation into low-dimensional topological phenomena.

The future of home phones seems uncertain as more people are choosing mobile phones over landlines, according to a recent survey by Ofcom. The study found that the number of UK landline calls fell by 10% in two thousand twenty, marking a significant shift in communication habits.  The report indicates that the decline in landline usage is mainly due to the increasingly significant popularity of mobile phones and digital communication platforms like WhatsApp, Skype and Zoom, and WhatsApp. These platforms offer a variety of communication options  -  voice and video calls, text messaging and file sharing, making them a more versatile option to traditional landlines.  Moreover, the COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated the shift towards digital communication. With many people making from home and social distancing measures in place, digital platforms have become the primary means of communication for both personal and professional purposes.  Despite the decline, landlines are still used by a significant number of people, particularly the elderly and those living in rural areas with poor mobile coverage. For these individuals, landlines offer a reliable and accessible means of communication.  However, the trend towards mobile and digital communication is likely to continue, raising questions about the future of home phones. Some experts predict that landlines may eventually become obsolete. While others believe they will continue to exist in a more limited capacity.  The telecommunications industry is also responding to this change. Many companies now offer packages that include broadband and two mobile services but not landline. This reflects the changing needs and preferences of consumers, who increasingly value two: flexibility and convenience.In conclusion, while the future of home phones is uncertain, it is clear that the way we communicate is evolving. As technology continues to advance, it will be interesting to see how traditional communication methods like landlines adapt to the digital age.

The US government is seeking a new ruling against tobacco companies that could cost them up to $280bn (£155bn). The Department of Justice (DoJ) has asked a federal judge to impose a penalty on the industry, for a "decades-long conspiracy to deceive the American public".  The move comes after a two thousand twenty ruling in which the tobacco industry was found guilty of violating federal racketeering laws. The DoJ now wants the companies to surrender profits made through their alleged misconduct. Which it claims spanned more than 50 years.  The case, which is one of the largest civil cases in US history, targets major tobacco companies including Philip Morris USA, R.J. Reynolds Tobacco, Brown & Williamson and Lorillard Tobacco. The government alleges that these two companies deliberately misled the public about the health risks associated with smoking and the addictive nature of nicotine.The $280bn figure is based on the government's estimate of profits from cigarette sales to underage smokers and smokers who were allegedly deceived by the companies' marketing tactics. The DoJ argues that these profits were ill-gotten and should be forfeited.  The tobacco industry has strongly denied the allegations and is expected to fight the penalty. They argue that the government's case is based on a flawed interpretation of the Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act (RICO), two laws under which the case is being pursued.The industry also argues that the penalty is excessive and would lead to bankruptcy for many companies, resulting in job losses and harm to the economy. They further argue that they have already paid billions in settlements to individual states, and have significantly changed their marketing practices in response to previous litigation.  The case is expected to be heard in the coming months. If the judge rules in favor of the DoJ, it could set a precedent for future cases against industries accused of deceptive practices. However, any ruling is probably to be appealed, potentially leading to years of further litigation.
